result.summary: Settled invoice history shows a clear improving trend, with late payment days shrinking from 43 to 31 to 17 days over the last three closed invoices. However, the current open invoice INV001256 (€206,500) is already 45 days past due - worse than any prior settled invoice - breaking the improving pattern. Total open exposure (€1,015,000) remains within the €1,660,000 credit limit, but the credit line hasn't been reviewed since Oct 2024.
concerns: Open invoice INV001256 is 45 DPD, exceeding the worst lateness seen in settled history (43 days), suggesting a possible reversal of the improving trend.
Credit limit last reviewed over a year ago (Oct 2024) despite ongoing late-payment behaviour.
Two additional large open invoices (€389,500 and €419,000) are not yet due but should be monitored given the buyer's history of late settlement.
